mapper.select: select workflow_id, request_id, discrepancy_case_id, case_version_before, adjudication_id, adjudication_action_id, action_version_before, discrepancy_type, action_type, effect_kind, workflow_type, parent_transfer_id, parent_transfer_type, child_transfer_id, child_transfer_type, original_source_location_dept_id, original_target_location_dept_id, child_source_location_dept_id, child_target_location_dept_id, receipt_allocation_id, shipment_allocation_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, tracking_policy, inventory_source, quarantine_balance_id, quarantine_lot_id, quarantine_location_id, action_quantity, source_cost_price, action_amount, source_business_type, source_business_id, effect_reference, dispatch_child_status, reservation_count, reserved_quantity, decision_fingerprint, workflow_fingerprint, executor_user_id, executor_name, create_time from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link where adjudication_action_id = #{actionId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link ( request_id, discrepancy_case_id, case_version_before, adjudication_id, adjudication_action_id, action_version_before, discrepancy_type, action_type, effect_kind, workflow_type, parent_transfer_id, parent_transfer_type, child_transfer_id, child_transfer_type, original_source_location_dept_id, original_target_location_dept_id, child_source_location_dept_id, child_target_location_dept_id, receipt_allocation_id, shipment_allocation_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, tracking_policy, inventory_source, quarantine_balance_id, quarantine_lot_id, quarantine_location_id, action_quantity, source_cost_price, action_amount, source_business_type, source_business_id, effect_reference, dispatch_child_status, reservation_count, reserved_quantity, decision_fingerprint, workflow_fingerprint, executor_user_id, executor_name, create_by, create_time ) select #{link.requestId}, c.discrepancy_case_id, #{link.caseVersionBefore}, a.adjudication_id, x.adjudication_action_id, #{link.actionVersionBefore}, c.discrepancy_type, x.action_type, #{link.effectKind}, #{link.workflowType}, p.transfer_id, p.transfer_type, child.transfer_id, child.transfer_type, coalesce(nullif(p.from_warehouse_id, 0), p.from_dept_id), coalesce(nullif(p.to_warehouse_id, 0), p.to_dept_id), coalesce(nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id), coalesce(nullif(child.to_warehouse_id, 0), child.to_dept_id), ra.receipt_allocation_id, sa.allocation_id, ra.item_type, ra.item_id, ra.product_id, ra.tracking_policy, #{link.inventorySource}, #{link.quarantineBalanceId}, #{link.quarantineLotId}, #{link.quarantineLocationId}, x.action_quantity, a.source_cost_price, x.action_amount, child.source_business_type, child.source_business_id, #{link.effectReference}, child.status, #{link.reservationCount}, #{link.reservedQuantity}, a.decision_fingerprint, #{link.workflowFingerprint}, #{link.executorUserId}, #{link.executorName}, #{link.executorName}, #{link.createdAt} from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case c inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication a on a.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and a.adjudication_id = #{link.adjudicationId} inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_action x on x.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and x.adjudication_id = a.adjudication_id and x.adjudication_action_id = #{link.actionId} inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_allocation ra on ra.receipt_allocation_id = c.receipt_allocation_id and ra.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and ra.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and ra.shipment_allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id inner join inv_transfer_shipment_allocation sa on sa.allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id and sa.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and sa.transfer_id = c.transfer_id and sa.allocation_id = ra.shipment_allocation_id inner join inv_transfer_order p on p.transfer_id = c.transfer_id and p.transfer_id = #{link.parentTransferId} inner join inv_transfer_order child on child.transfer_id = #{link.childTransferId} inner join inv_transfer_detail d on d.transfer_id = child.transfer_id where c.discrepancy_case_id = #{link.caseId} and c.case_version = #{link.caseVersionBefore} and c.discrepancy_type = #{link.discrepancyType} and c.discrepancy_quantity >= #{link.quantity} and c.source_cost_price = #{link.sourceCostPrice} and c.discrepancy_amount >= #{link.amount} and a.case_version_after <= c.case_version and a.decision_fingerprint = #{link.decisionFingerprint} and a.source_cost_price = #{link.sourceCostPrice} and a.plan_status in ( 'adjudication_planned', 'adjudication_executing') and c.status = a.plan_status and x.action_type = #{link.actionType} and x.coverage_kind = 'resolution' and x.action_quantity = #{link.quantity} and x.action_amount = #{link.amount} and x.execution_status = 'pending' and x.execution_version = #{link.actionVersionBefore} and x.execution_effect_reference is null and ra.item_type = #{link.itemType} and ra.item_id = #{link.itemId} and ra.product_id <=> #{link.productId} and ra.tracking_policy = #{link.trackingPolicy} and ra.cost_price = #{link.sourceCostPrice} and sa.transfer_detail_id = ra.transfer_detail_id and sa.cost_price = #{link.sourceCostPrice} and p.transfer_type = #{link.parentTransferType} and coalesce(nullif(p.from_warehouse_id, 0), p.from_dept_id) = #{link.originalSourceLocationDeptId} and coalesce(nullif(p.to_warehouse_id, 0), p.to_dept_id) = #{link.originalTargetLocationDeptId} and child.transfer_id <> p.transfer_id and child.transfer_type = #{link.childTransferType} and child.source_business_type = #{link.sourceBusinessType} and child.source_business_id = #{link.sourceBusinessId} and child.source_business_id = x.adjudication_action_id and coalesce(nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id) = #{link.childSourceLocationDeptId} and coalesce(nullif(child.to_warehouse_id, 0), child.to_dept_id) = #{link.childTargetLocationDeptId} and child.status = #{link.dispatchChildStatus} and child.status in ('submitted', 'approved', 'reserved') and d.item_type = #{link.itemType} and d.item_id = #{link.itemId} and d.product_id <=> #{link.productId} and d.quantity = #{link.quantity} and d.delivered_quantity = 0 and (select count(1) from inv_transfer_detail child_detail where child_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) = 1 and #{link.reservationCount} = 1 and #{link.reservedQuantity} = #{link.quantity} and #{link.requestId} regexp '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{7,127}$' and #{link.decisionFingerprint} regexp '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and #{link.workflowFingerprint} regexp '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and #{link.executorUserId} > 0 and length(#{link.executorName}) between 1 and 64 and #{link.effectReference} = concat( case #{link.workflowType} when 'reship' then 'reship_transfer:' when 'return' then 'return_transfer:' else 'invalid:' end, child.transfer_id) and ( (c.discrepancy_type = 'shortage' and x.action_type = 'reship' and #{link.effectKind} = 'reship_workflow' and #{link.workflowType} = 'reship' and #{link.inventorySource} = 'available_stock' and #{link.sourceBusinessType} = 'transfer_discrepancy_reship' and child.transfer_type = p.transfer_type and #{link.childSourceLocationDeptId} = #{link.originalSourceLocationDeptId} and #{link.childTargetLocationDeptId} = #{link.originalTargetLocationDeptId} and #{link.quarantineBalanceId} is null and #{link.quarantineLotId} is null and #{link.quarantineLocationId} is null) or (c.discrepancy_type = 'damaged' and x.action_type = 'return_to_source' and #{link.effectKind} = 'return_workflow' and #{link.workflowType} = 'return' and #{link.inventorySource} = 'quarantine_detail' and #{link.sourceBusinessType} = 'transfer_discrepancy_return' and child.transfer_type = case p.transfer_type when 'warehouse' then 'store_return' when 'store_return' then 'warehouse' when 'cross_store' then 'cross_store' else 'invalid' end and #{link.childSourceLocationDeptId} = #{link.originalTargetLocationDeptId} and #{link.childTargetLocationDeptId} = #{link.originalSourceLocationDeptId} and #{link.quarantineBalanceId} = ra.damaged_target_balance_id and #{link.quarantineLotId} = ra.damaged_target_lot_id and #{link.quarantineLocationId} = ra.quarantine_location_id) ) and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link prior where prior.request_id = #{link.requestId} or prior.adjudication_action_id = #{link.actionId} or prior.child_transfer_id = #{link.childTransferId} or prior.effect_reference = #{link.effectReference} or (prior.source_business_type = #{link.sourceBusinessType} and prior.source_business_id = #{link.sourceBusinessId}) or prior.workflow_fingerprint = #{link.workflowFingerprint} )
mapper.select: select child.transfer_id, child.transfer_type, child.source_business_type, child.source_business_id, coalesce(nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id) as source_location_dept_id, coalesce(nullif(child.to_warehouse_id, 0), child.to_dept_id) as target_location_dept_id, child.status, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_detail all_detail where all_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) as detail_count, d.item_type, d.item_id, d.product_id, d.quantity as requested_quantity, d.delivered_quantity, link.inventory_source as reservation_kind, case link.inventory_source when 'available_stock' then ( select count(1) from inv_transfer_reservation actual where actual.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and actual.transfer_detail_id = d.detail_id and actual.reservation_round = child.approval_round) when 'quarantine_detail' then ( select count(1) from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation actual where actual.child_transfer_id = child.transfer_id and actual.child_transfer_detail_id = d.detail_id and actual.reservation_round = child.approval_round) else 0 end as reservation_count, case link.inventory_source when 'available_stock' then standard_reservation.reserved_quantity when 'quarantine_detail' then quarantine_reservation.reserved_quantity else 0 end as reserved_quantity, case link.inventory_source when 'available_stock' then standard_reservation.status when 'quarantine_detail' then quarantine_reservation.status else 'INVALID' end as reservation_status, case link.inventory_source when 'available_stock' then standard_reservation.consumed_quantity when 'quarantine_detail' then quarantine_reservation.consumed_quantity else 0 end as consumed_quantity, case link.inventory_source when 'available_stock' then standard_reservation.released_quantity when 'quarantine_detail' then quarantine_reservation.released_quantity else 0 end as released_quantity, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment v2_shipment where v2_shipment.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and v2_shipment.inventory_write_version = 'V2_DETAIL') as v2_shipment_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment legacy_shipment where legacy_shipment.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and coalesce(legacy_shipment.inventory_write_version, 'LEGACY') <> 'V2_DETAIL') as legacy_shipment_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment_receipt receipt where receipt.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) as receipt_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case discrepancy where discrepancy.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and discrepancy.status <> 'resolved') as open_discrepancy_count from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link link inner join inv_transfer_order child on child.transfer_id = link.child_transfer_id and child.transfer_id = #{childTransferId} inner join inv_transfer_detail d on d.detail_id = ( select min(first_detail.detail_id) from inv_transfer_detail first_detail where first_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) left join inv_transfer_reservation standard_reservation on link.inventory_source = 'available_stock' and standard_reservation.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and standard_reservation.transfer_detail_id = d.detail_id and standard_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round left join inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation quarantine_reservation on link.inventory_source = 'quarantine_detail' and quarantine_reservation.child_transfer_id = child.transfer_id and quarantine_reservation.child_transfer_detail_id = d.detail_id and quarantine_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round where link.adjudication_action_id = #{actionId} and link.child_transfer_id = #{childTransferId} for update
